testimonials.quote: Raju photographed our wedding like a family member who understood every quiet ritual. Looking back at our album, we can feel the morning rain and the tears in my mother's eyes.
We were afraid of being awkward in front of the camera, but Raju never asked us to pose stiffly. He just walked with us through the Lambasingi pine forest. The photographs feel alive.
In an era of artificial lights and flashing gear, Raju's natural light photography of our granddaughter's naming ceremony captured the soul of our village home.
